description: Agent Completion Messages and Work Progress Templates

data_extraction.starting: Starting data extraction from submission documents...
processing: Scanning document structure and identifying data fields
Extracting client information and policy details
Validating extracted data against required fields
Calculating confidence scores for each data point
Preparing data for human review and approval
data_extraction.completion: Data extraction completed successfully. Found {field_count} fields with average confidence of {confidence_percentage}%. Ready for human review.

processing: Searching client information against sanctions databases
Cross-referencing with regulatory watch lists
Analyzing risk factors and compliance requirements
Generating risk assessment report
Preparing recommendations for review
sanctions_check.completion: Sanctions screening completed. Client risk level: {risk_level}. Status: {sanctions_status}. {additional_notes}

processing: Analyzing risk factors and coverage requirements
Calculating base premium from actuarial tables
Applying risk adjustments and market factors
Reviewing competitor pricing and market conditions
Finalizing premium recommendation with justification
premium_calculation.completion: Premium calculation completed. Recommended premium: £{premium_amount}. Base rate: £{base_premium}, Risk adjustment: {risk_adjustment}%.

processing: Gathering policy details and decision information
Structuring email content with key information
Formatting professional insurance communication
Including required next steps and contact details
Preparing email for human review and approval
email_draft.completion: Email draft completed for {recipient_name}. Subject: '{email_subject}'. Content includes policy details, premium information, and next steps.

processing: Validating recipient email address and format
Preparing email content and attachments
Connecting to email service provider
Sending email and tracking delivery status
Confirming successful delivery and logging
email_sender.completion: Email sent successfully to {recipient_email}. Message ID: {message_id}. Delivery confirmed at {timestamp}.

risk_profile.starting: Analyzing risk profile and conversion probability...
processing: Evaluating client history and risk factors
Analyzing property type and location risk
Assessing broker relationship and market conditions
Calculating conversion probability using risk models
Generating risk score and recommendation
risk_profile.completion: Risk profile analysis completed. Conversion probability: {conversion_probability}%. Risk score: {risk_score}/100. Recommendation: {recommendation}.

processing: Reviewing all agent results and decisions
Analyzing workflow completion status
Preparing comprehensive summary report
Identifying next steps and follow-up actions
Documenting final recommendations
final_decision.completion: Workflow completed successfully. Status: {workflow_status}. Final decision: {decision_summary}. Next steps: {next_steps}.

processing: Checking slip reference format and validity
Validating syndicate participation percentages
Verifying coverage terms and conditions
Ensuring compliance with Lloyd's market standards
Preparing validation report with recommendations
slip_validation.completion: Slip validation completed. Reference: {slip_reference}. Validation status: {validation_status}. Total capacity: {total_capacity}%.

processing: Reviewing policy limits and deductibles
Analyzing coverage scope and exclusions
Identifying potential gaps or overlaps
Comparing against industry standards
Preparing coverage adequacy assessment
coverage_analysis.completion: Coverage analysis completed. Policy limits: £{policy_limits}. Coverage adequacy: {coverage_rating}. Recommendations: {recommendations}.

processing: Analyzing client industry and risk profile
Reviewing loss history and claims data
Evaluating risk control measures
Assessing geographical and operational risks
Preparing detailed risk assessment report
risk_assessment.completion: Risk assessment completed. Overall risk rating: {risk_rating}. Key risk factors: {risk_factors}. Mitigation recommendations provided.

processing: Analyzing market conditions and competitor rates
Calculating technical pricing based on risk factors
Adjusting for capacity and market appetite
Preparing pricing recommendations
Documenting pricing rationale and assumptions
pricing.completion: Pricing analysis completed. Recommended rate: {pricing_rate}. Technical price: £{technical_price}. Market adjustment: {market_adjustment}%.

processing: Compiling all slip terms and conditions
Formatting according to Lloyd's market standards
Including all syndicate participation details
Preparing signing pages and documentation
Finalizing slip for market presentation
documentation.completion: Documentation completed. Slip {slip_reference} ready for market. Total syndicate participation: {participation_count} syndicates, {total_capacity}% capacity.
